csv_project_name: Engineering for E. New Haven Downtown Retrofit & Streetscape
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Melbourne requires professional consulting engineering services for East New Haven Avenue in historical downtown Melbourne and other streets adjacent to the downtown. Design elements include roadway design to allow for the conversion of angled parking to parallel parking along E. New Haven Avenue to accommodate wider sidewalks in compliance with the American with Disabilities Act (ADA); storm water collection system design, utility relocation design including laterals, fire hydrants, water services, sewer services; landscape, irrigation, hardscape designs, including decorative crosswalks, tree wells, seating benches, trash receptacles; pedestrian and roadway decorative lighting design and other ancillary design. The City of Melbourne is proposing a complete retrofit of historic downtown, utilizing an urban-style streetscape and roadway design for the following segments of roadway: 1. Full reconstruction of E. New Haven Avenue, from Livingston Street to the FloridaEast Coast Railway (FECR), (1,600 linear feet) 2. Full reconstruction of E. New Haven Avenue, from FECR to US1 (488 linear feet). 3. Full reconstruction of Municipal Lane, between US 192 and E. New Haven Avenue, (287 linear feet). 4. Full reconstruction of Melbourne Court, from FECR to Henley Court, (250 linear feet). 5. Milling and resurfacing and with other right of way improvements: E. New Haven Avenue, from US1 to just east of Front Street, (1,000 linear feet). Design services include surveying, geotechnical services, roadway design, drainage design, subsurface utility exploration and utility design, lighting design, landscape design, hardscape design and public outreach/involvement.
csv_disciplines_requested: Planning/Master Planning, Sanitation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics, Stormwater, Traffic Design Engineering, Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping
